build.buildCommand: NPM_CONFIG_PRODUCTION=false npm ci --prefix pillow && NPM_CONFIG_PRODUCTION=false npm ci --prefix backend && node scripts/sync-pillow-governance.mjs && npm run build --prefix pillow && npm run build --prefix backend

deploy.startCommand: sh -c 'exec redis-server --bind 0.0.0.0 :: --protected-mode yes --port 6379 --dir /data --requirepass "$REDIS_PASSWORD" --maxmemory 268435456 --maxmemory-policy noeviction --appendonly yes --appendfsync always'
